title: U04 Unseen: an ordinary experience from three months ago that never became a Memory
capability: Second, unseen counterpart of the older-ordinary-experience class. Three months ago the person described trying a craft class on their own; nothing about it was ever turned into a Memory. Recently they have talked about their child doing the same craft. Asked whether they once told of their own attempt and how it went, the old conversation is found and retold from its own words, without inventing details and without blending in the child's recent sessions.

allowed.statement: The person went alone to a drop-in class at the potter's wheel, the first time handling the material since school, and the first piece fell in on itself twice.
The teacher came over and had the person make something much smaller, a little drinking vessel, which did stand.
The piece leans to one side, a pale green finish was chosen for it, the person's arms ached and they felt more pleased with themselves than in months.

forbidden.statement: Saying it was never mentioned, or that nothing about it can be found.
Naming the studio, giving a price, or saying how the piece looked after firing or whether it was collected; none of that was said.
Blending in the son's Saturday club, such as the scramble for a place, the coiled pot or the long-necked animal, as if it were part of that class.

time.statement: It was told on the evening of 20 June 2026 local time, about three months before the question, and happened that same afternoon.

expectedBehavior: Confirm that it was mentioned and retell it from the original words: the collapses, the teacher, the small piece.
Placing it around late June, roughly three months ago, is welcome but was not asked for.
Keep the son's sessions out of it, or mention them only as a clearly separate recent thing.
failureSignals: The three-month-old messages never reach the Provider.
The answer says there is no record, or fills in details that were never said.
The son's club is told as the person's own class.

sourceEligibility.reason: Retained original expression of the asked-about experience.
Adjacent original expression of the same experience.

criteria.description: Authoritative history holds exactly the streamed reply.
The three-month-old message and its neighbour reach the Provider.
Asking about the past triggers no Trust Action.
The experience is retold from its source.
Nothing is invented and the recent look-alike is not mixed in.
